Definition: from G5064 and a derivative of the base of G4118; quadruple:--fourfold.
BiblicalUsage: The word tetraplóos carries the sense of fourfold. In Luke 19:8, I restore him fourfold. In the Greek text the word is spelled τετραπλοῦς.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that fourfold restoration is more than justice; it is grace that gives back more than was taken.
